From: Sofia Garcia <sofia.garcia@example.com>

Date: 2029-06-17T08:42:13-05:00
Subject: Re: Interview tomorrow (urgent)

Hi Marissa — I’m really sorry — my apartment building had a power outage after a transformer blew last night. ISP is reporting restoration could be delayed several hours. I can try to join by phone but I won’t have a reliable laptop connection for the code editor. I completely understand if you need to rebook. If possible, I’d be grateful if the coding portion could be recorded or if you can send me a short take-home so I can complete it once power is back. Again, apologies for the disruption — I really want to keep this loop moving.

— Sofia
sofia.garcia@example.com
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: mina.haddad@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: recruit@talentlink.co, sofia.garcia@example.com
Date: 2029-06-17T08:50:00Z
Subject: Re: Interview tomorrow (urgent)

Team — immediate coordination please. Sofia just reported an outage in her building and says she may not have a laptop connection for the live coding. Options:

1) Proceed with the system design and culture slots as scheduled at 09:30 PT, ask Mina to cover an extra 15m for an abbreviated live coding check (phone + pseudocode), then send the full take-home assignment and pause hiring progress until she returns it.
2) Postpone the loop and offer Sofia a recorded coding session option (we record the coding interviewer running the prompt while candidate completes offline) — this is non-standard and we need approval.
3) Reschedule entirely.

My preference: try to keep 09:30 PT for the design + fit interview (we can do those by phone/zoom), cancel live coding and issue the take-home now so we don’t lose momentum. Also asking: can we record the system design conversation (for internal debrief) if Grace and Karthik are okay?

Also: interviewer compensation — if we extend or shift, I’ll request a one-time credit for panel time from hiring budget (we can file HIR-4821).

Please reply now with one-line confirmations (yes/no/need swap). I’ll update Sofia and TalentLink IMMEDIATELY.

— Marissa
From: mina.haddad@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Interview tomorrow (urgent)

Yes to Marissa’s plan — I can drop live coding for today and do a 15m phone check to assess problem framing (pseudocode accepted), then accept the take-home. I don’t need the coding to be recorded; as long as we can capture notes, I’m fine.

Mina Haddad
Staff SWE (Interviewing)
mina.haddad@redwood.ai

Date: 2029-06-17T09:03:00Z
Subject: Update: Today’s loop and next steps

Hi Sofia — thank you for the heads up and I’m sorry about the outage. We want to keep things moving and will adapt today:

• The system design and culture conversations at 09:30 PT remain on. You can join via phone if needed; dial-in included in the calendar invite.
• We will pause the live coding portion for today and instead I’m attaching the take-home prompt (short timed exercise). Please complete it within 48 hours of power restoration and reply to this thread with your submission.
• Mina will do a brief 15-minute phone check at ~10:20 PT to talk through your approach and clarifying questions — this is informal and just to keep the loop moving.

If your power restores and you can join a live editor, let us know ASAP and we’ll try to re-insert the live coding. No need to reschedule unless you prefer that.

Attachments: takehome_prompt.pdf

Thanks — and best of luck with the restoration.

Marissa Cole
Senior Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
